# ScottSearch 0.1.0 — human-testing release

ScottSearch is ready for its first round of real-vault testing. It is a native Obsidian search view that favors ten carefully ranked notes over a wall of textual matches.

## What you can test

- Relevance-ranked wording search, with ten results by default.
- Optional meaning-based ranking through a local Ollama embedding model.
- Required terms and phrases such as `+consensus` and `+"decision record"`.
- Exclusions such as `-draft` and `-"split brain"`.
- Path, filename, tag, extension, created-date, and modified-date filters.
- Sorting, result facets, keyboard navigation, and automatic index updates.

## Install

The `scottsearch-0.1.0.zip` asset is the same for macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, iPadOS, and Android. It contains `main.js`, `manifest.json`, and `styles.css` in a `scottsearch` folder.

For the friendliest beta installation, use the BRAT community plugin and add:

```text
c4g-john/scottsearch-for-obsidian
```

The [ScottSearch website](https://c4g-john.github.io/scottsearch-for-obsidian/#install) has illustrated, no-code installation and testing steps.

## Before you test

This is a pre-release. Back up important notes and keep a normal Obsidian test or recovery plan. ScottSearch does not modify note contents, and disabling or removing it does not delete notes.

Semantic ranking is optional and off by default. Without it, note content stays inside Obsidian. When enabled, note text is sent only to the Ollama endpoint configured in ScottSearch settings.

## Tell us what happened

- [Share a feature need](https://github.com/c4g-john/scottsearch-for-obsidian/issues/new?template=product_requirement.yml)
- [Report a bug](https://github.com/c4g-john/scottsearch-for-obsidian/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)

GitHub issues are public. Please replace private note text and vault paths with fictional examples.

## Known limits

- ScottSearch has not yet completed Obsidian community-plugin review.
- Optional semantic ranking currently requires a reachable Ollama service.
- Real-vault relevance, very large vaults, themes, and mobile devices need broader testing.
